advancement.hint: Humans vary widely in height and build, from barely 5 feet to well over 6 feet tall. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

advancement.title: Fighting Style
advancement.hint: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the following options. You can’t take a Fighting Style option more than once, even if you later get to choose again.
Dwarves stand between 4 and 5 feet tall and average about 150 pounds. Your size is Medium.
You have acquired greater mental strength. You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.
Gnomes are between 3 and 4 feet tall and average about 40 pounds. Your size is Small.

advancement.title: Signature Spells
advancement.hint: Choose two 3rd-level wizard spells in your spellbook as your signature spells.

materials.value: A tiny bell and a piece of fine silver wire.

effects.name: Mage Armor
effects.description: The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier.

materials.value: 10 gp worth of charcoal, incense, and herbs that must be consumed by fire in a brass brazier
A pinch of fine sand, rose petals, or a cricket.

effects.name: Sleep
effects.description: The creature affected by this spell falls Unconscious until the spell ends, the sleeper takes damage, or someone uses an action to shake or slap the sleeper awake.

activation.condition: Which you take when you are hit by an attack or targeted by the magic missile spell

effects.name: Shield
effects.description: Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from magic missile.

advancement.title: Draconic Ancestry
advancement.hint: You have draconic ancestry. Choose one type of dragon from the list. Your breath weapon and damage resistance are determined by the dragon type.
Dragonborn are taller and heavier than humans, standing well over 6 feet tall and averaging almost 250 pounds. Your size is Medium.
You have resistance to the damage type associated with your draconic ancestry.

effects.name: Bane
effects.description: Whenever the target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw.

materials.value: A drop of water if creating water or a few grains of sand if destroying it.
A small parchment with a bit of holy text written on it.

effects.name: Shield of Faith
effects.description: The target gains it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

materials.value: Holy water or powdered silver and iron, which the spell consumes
